# Security King

> Security King (securityking.com.ua) is a Ukrainian multi-brand online store of security and backup power equipment, with a pickup point in Kyiv and delivery across Ukraine. Besides selling equipment, the company advises on equipment selection and installs and configures it.

Key facts (as of 2026-11-06):

- Business type: retailer, not a manufacturer. Seller: sole proprietor (FOP); legal details are in the Public Offer.
- Address and pickup point: 6A Oleny Pchilky St. (вул. Олени Пчілки, 6А), Kyiv; pickup by prior arrangement.
- Contacts: (098) 60-30-200 (Kyivstar), (073) 60-30-200 (lifecell), sale@securityking.com.ua, Viber +380986030200, Telegram https://t.me/ChatSecurityKing.
- Hours: managers Mon–Fri 10:00–18:00, closed Sat–Sun; online orders are accepted 24/7.
- Customers: private customers and businesses (LLCs and FOPs, payment by invoice).
- Services: equipment selection for a specific site; installation and configuration. Prices and service area are confirmed by a manager.
- Main brands: Ajax, Hikvision, Dahua, Reolink, IMOU, EZVIZ, TECSAR, EcoFlow, Deye, Full Energy, Trinix, Atis.
- Prices in Ukrainian hryvnia (UAH). Site language: Ukrainian; /ru/ is a Russian duplicate.

How to use this file:

- Take prices and availability only from the product page.
- Product URLs follow https://securityking.com.ua/<slug>; do not guess slugs, navigate from a category or brand page.
- Do not state that installation is available in a specific city without a manager's confirmation.

## Purchase Terms

- [Delivery & Payment](https://securityking.com.ua/dostavka-i-oplata): Minimum order UAH 300. Nova Poshta courier in Kyiv: UAH 100, free from UAH 5,000, next-day delivery for orders placed before 16:00 (item in stock in Kyiv). Nova Poshta branches across Ukraine: carrier rates, free from UAH 2,500; same-day dispatch for orders before 16:00, otherwise 1–3 days. Pickup is free. Bulky items by arrangement. Payment: on receipt (cash or card); online (Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay); by invoice for LLCs and FOPs, shipped after payment is received.
- [Warranty](https://securityking.com.ua/garantiy): 12 months from the date of sale unless another period is stated for the product (some products carry a manufacturer warranty of up to 5 years). Warranty card and receipt required; shipping to the service center at the buyer's expense; repair within 30 days, a temporary replacement may be provided meanwhile; if repair is impossible, the item is replaced with an equivalent.
- [Returns](https://securityking.com.ua/vozvrat): Goods of proper quality can be exchanged or returned within 14 days under the Ukrainian Consumer Protection Law, unused and with a receipt. Refunds are made within 30 days after the seller receives the item.
- [Cashback](https://securityking.com.ua/cashback): 10% in bonus points on full-price Ajax products in the Alarm Systems and Video Surveillance categories; credited within 24 hours, spent on the next order; not available for used equipment.
- [Contact Us](https://securityking.com.ua/contact-us/): Phone numbers, address, working hours, callback request.
- [Public Offer](https://securityking.com.ua/publichna-oferta): Sales contract and seller's legal details.

## Video Surveillance

- [Video Surveillance](https://securityking.com.ua/videosposterezhennia/): Cameras, recorders, kits, hard drives, memory cards, microphones, body cameras, video signal transmitters, brackets.
- [CCTV Kits](https://securityking.com.ua/komplekty-videosposterezhennia/): Ready-made video surveillance kits from Hikvision, Reolink, Ajax, Dahua and ZKTeco.
- [Surveillance Cameras](https://securityking.com.ua/kamery-videosposterezhennia/): IP, HDCVI, Wi-Fi and 4G cameras, including battery-powered models with solar panels, from Dahua, Hikvision, TECSAR, Ajax, Reolink, IMOU and EZVIZ.
- [3G/4G Cameras](https://securityking.com.ua/kamery-videosposterezhennia/kamery-4g): SIM-card cameras for sites without internet, including battery and solar-powered models.
- [Battery-Powered Cameras](https://securityking.com.ua/kamery-videosposterezhennia/kamery-z-akumuliatorom): Autonomous cameras with a battery and solar panel, no cabling required.
- [Wi-Fi Cameras](https://securityking.com.ua/kamery-videosposterezhennia/wi-fi-kamery): Home cameras controlled from a smartphone.
- [Video Recorders](https://securityking.com.ua/videoreiestratory/): NVR, XVR and TurboHD recorders from Hikvision, Provision-ISR, Dahua, Ajax and Reolink.

## Alarm Systems

- [Alarm Systems](https://securityking.com.ua/okhoronni-syhnalizatsii/): Wireless and wired systems from Ajax, U-Prox, Tiras, Atis and Hikvision: control panels, detectors, sirens, keypads, key fobs, range extenders.
- [Alarm Kits](https://securityking.com.ua/komplekty-syhnalizatsii/): Ready-made alarm kits, mostly Ajax, as well as U-Prox and Atis.
- [Control Panels](https://securityking.com.ua/tsentrali/): Ajax hubs and Tiras, U-Prox, Atis and Hikvision control panels.
- [Alarm Detectors](https://securityking.com.ua/datchyky-okhoronnoi-syhnalizatsii/): Opening, motion, outdoor and vibration detectors from Trinix, Atis, Ajax and U-Prox.

## Intercoms

- [Intercom Systems](https://securityking.com.ua/domofonni-systemy/): Video intercoms, call panels and audio intercoms from BCOM, NeoLight, Slinex, Hikvision and Dahua.
- [Video Intercom Kits](https://securityking.com.ua/komplekty-videodomofoniv/): Intercom kits, including Wi-Fi kits, from BCOM and NeoLight.
- [Video Doorbells](https://securityking.com.ua/videodzvinky/): Video doorbells from Reolink, Ajax, ZKTeco, EZVIZ and Provision-ISR.

## Smart Home

- [Smart Home](https://securityking.com.ua/rozumnyi-budynok/): Home automation, mostly Ajax: relays, sockets, switches, sensors, integration modules.
- [Anti-Flood](https://securityking.com.ua/antypotop/): Leak protection kits, leak detectors and water shut-off valves, mostly Ajax, as well as U-Prox.

## Access Control Systems

- [Access Control](https://securityking.com.ua/kontrol-dostupu/): Electric locks, readers, controllers, exit buttons, door closers, access cards and parking barriers from Atis, Trinix, Yli Electronic, ZKTeco and U-Prox.
- [Electric Locks](https://securityking.com.ua/elektrozamky/): Electromagnetic, electric bolt, electromechanical and motorized locks and electric strikes from Yli Electronic, Atis, Trinix and Yale.
- [Smart Locks](https://securityking.com.ua/smart-zamky/): Biometric and smart locks from Trinix, Atis, ZKTeco, Yale and Ajax.

## Power Systems

- [Power Systems](https://securityking.com.ua/systemy-zhyvlennia/): Power for security systems and homes during blackouts: from 12 V power supplies and 220 V UPS units to hybrid inverters.
- [Backup Power Kits](https://securityking.com.ua/komplekty-rezervnoho-zhyvlennia/): Uninterruptible and backup power kits from Full Energy, Trinix, Kraft and Ajax.
- [Power Stations](https://securityking.com.ua/zariadni-stantsii/): Portable power stations from EcoFlow, Kraft, Full Energy, EZVIZ and Zendure.
- [UPS 12-48V](https://securityking.com.ua/bloky-bezperebiinoho-zhyvlennia-12v/): Low-voltage uninterruptible power supplies and UPS boards from Via Energy and Full Energy, including DIN-rail models.
- [UPS for Routers](https://securityking.com.ua/bezperebiinyky-router/): Mini UPS units for Wi-Fi routers and optical terminals from Full Energy, Trinix, SKE and Step4Net.
- [Batteries](https://securityking.com.ua/akumuliatory/): AGM, gel and LiFePO4 12 V batteries for alarm systems and backup power from Full Energy, Ritar, Deye and Trinix.
- [Inverters](https://securityking.com.ua/invertory/): Hybrid inverters, LiFePO4 battery modules and accessories from Deye and Full Energy.
- [Solar Panels](https://securityking.com.ua/soniachni-paneli/): Solar panels for power stations and cameras from Kraft, Reolink, Full Energy and EcoFlow.

## Other Categories

- [Cable](https://securityking.com.ua/kabel/): Twisted pair (OK-Net, Atis), coaxial and combined coaxial cable (Atis, Odeskabel, Finmark).
- [Used Equipment](https://securityking.com.ua/vzhyvane/): Used Ajax equipment at reduced prices: detectors, hubs, range extenders, keypads and buttons.

## Brand Pages

- [Brands](https://securityking.com.ua/brands/): All brands in the store; a brand page at https://securityking.com.ua/<brand> lists all of its products.
- [Ajax](https://securityking.com.ua/ajax): Ukrainian manufacturer of wireless security systems: alarms, cameras, smart home, anti-flood.
- [Dahua](https://securityking.com.ua/dahua): IP and HDCVI cameras, recorders, intercoms, PoE switches.
- [Deye](https://securityking.com.ua/deye): Hybrid inverters and LiFePO4 batteries.
- [EcoFlow](https://securityking.com.ua/ecoflow): Portable power stations and solar panels.
- [Hikvision](https://securityking.com.ua/hikvision): IP and TurboHD cameras, recorders, intercoms.
- [Reolink](https://securityking.com.ua/reolink): Wi-Fi, PoE and battery cameras, kits, video doorbells.
- [TECSAR](https://securityking.com.ua/tecsar): 4G and solar-powered cameras, body cameras.
- [ZKTeco](https://securityking.com.ua/zkteco): Access control, smart locks, readers, CCTV kits, parking barriers.

## Blog Posts

- [Blog](https://securityking.com.ua/blog/): Articles, news, device reviews (Ajax FireProtect 2, Ajax KeyPad TouchScreen) and practical tips, including keeping Ajax running during power outages.
- [How to Choose a Security System for a House](https://securityking.com.ua/yak-vybraty-systemu-bezpeky-dlia-budynku): Tips on choosing a security system for a private house.
- [Ajax WaterStop: Reliable Anti-Flood System](https://securityking.com.ua/ajax-waterstop-nadiina-antypotop-systema): How the Ajax WaterStop valve shuts off water automatically or remotely from the Ajax app.
